name: Troas
overview: Troas, a seaport in Mysia of Asia Minor, served as a significant location in the missionary journeys of the Apostle Paul. Scripture records Paul and his companions traveling to and from Troas, where they stayed for several days and where Paul found an open door to preach the gospel of Christ. This city also functioned as a point of departure and arrival during Paul's travels, and it is mentioned as the place where Paul left personal belongings to be retrieved later, reflecting its role in his ministry and personal life.
